structuralFindings: Currency USD (confirmed 'Currency USD' header) — not the EUR seen at Baobab.
Base meal plan ALL INCLUSIVE for the standard STO/Rack rates; a paid 'Premium All Inclusive' upgrade exists (see below), a materially different upsell shape than any Soroi property or Baobab.
5 room categories in this 2026 document: A=Bustani Garden, B=Pool Side, C=Junior Suite, D=Sea View, E=6 Bedroom Oasis Villa.
Room E (6 Bedroom Oasis Villa) is priced PER UNIT for 12 pax, not per person — a distinct pricing unit, same pattern flagged for Samburu Lodge's Executive Villa in CLAUDE.md.

Third adult (above 12yrs) = 30% (reduction, not clear if 30% of what base — read literally as printed, means 30% surcharge/rate; not independently disambiguated further).
Children under 2 free; 1st child 2-11.99yrs free; 2nd child 2-11.99yrs = 50%.
Single room supplement = 50%; one adult with children = 50% surcharge.
Minimum stay 5 nights during 23.12.2025-07.01.2026 festive window only.
Premium All Inclusive supplement: $75/person/night, adults only (18+), booked for all adults sharing the room, min 4 nights, not discountable.

10% Early Booking discount ladder exists, tied to specific booking-by dates per travel-date window — not combinable with other offers, applies to child/extra-bed/single rates too but NOT to Premium All Inclusive.

Cancellation policy differs structurally from Baobab's day-banded approach: flat 40% (30-10 days out), 60% (9-1 days out), 100% no-show; festive-period bookings have a hard cutoff (100% if cancelled after 15.10.2025 for stays in 21.12.25-07.01.26).
